text: Returns policy effective October: request a refund within thirty days of purchase. Shipping fees are excluded.
Superseded returns policy: request a refund within sixty days of purchase.
Standard delivery costs five pounds. Orders over fifty pounds have free shipping.
The shop opens Monday to Friday at nine and closes at six. It is closed on Sunday.
Damaged goods need supervisor review before refund approval. Record photographs with the claim.
Only the account owner may view an invoice. Staff need the billing-reader permission.
Download invoices from Account then Billing. An invoice download does not change a subscription.
Subscription cancellation takes effect at the next renewal. The service remains available until then.
